description: Counts pattern matches per file using ripgrep. Returns per-file match counts and totals.

countMatches.description: Count per-occurrence matches instead of per-line counts (--count-matches)

fixedStrings.description: Treat pattern as a literal string instead of regex (--fixed-strings)

invertMatch.description: Count non-matching lines instead of matching lines (--invert-match)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of files to include in results — truncates per-file list to prevent excessive output in large repos

noIgnore.description: Don't respect .gitignore and other ignore files (--no-ignore)

path.description: Directory or file to search in

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern to count matches for

sort.description: Sort results: 'path' for alphabetical by file path, 'count' for descending match count

type.description: Filter by file type (e.g., 'ts', 'js', 'py', 'rust'). Maps to --type TYPE.

name: count
title: Match Count
